entities.summary: Victoria, a notable figure in the history of Lesotho, associated with Moshoeshoe I and the Basotho Nation (1858–1868). Preceded by Wars with Orange Free State Boers and Moshoeshoe Requests British Protection 1868. Their legacy influenced Gun War 1880.
